target: Spoiler-free archival 100% documentation of the final official EA-Land service build

areas.name: Official Service Boundary
areas.location_cue: Archived Windows client records, EA-Land documentation, shutdown notices, and preserved final-session media.
areas.note: The authentic official service is closed; this pack documents its finite historical systems without pretending they are normally playable.

levels.1: The catalog selects the last official Windows service state.
levels.2: Treat the final EA-Land build as the authentic route.
levels.3: Use archival documentation from the final official service period. Do not substitute a community reimplementation when auditing what the EA-operated game contained.

levels.1: No normal EA-operated login world remains.
levels.2: Record the official route as unavailable.
levels.3: The EA service ended in 2008, so a new authentic character, property, career, or economy completion file cannot be created today.

levels.1: Later projects reproduce or extend systems but are different builds and services.
levels.2: Do not merge FreeSO, NewSO, or other private servers into this official pack.
levels.3: Audit those projects only under their own future entries. Their engines, servers, balance, added content, and account state cannot prove completion of the historical EA-Land service.

levels.1: The final public gathering is part of the service’s historical state.
levels.2: Retain reliable documentation of the official shutdown event.
levels.3: Archive the final-session footage, date, service notices, and scholarly preservation references alongside this pack; no gameplay recreation is claimed.
